name: anthias-viewer
description: Viewer & server application internals for Anthias — the server-rendered Django/ASGI + Redis pub/sub architecture, streaming-under-ASGI, SQLite WAL playlist reload, viewer memory/OOM behavior, upload codec gate, Sentry-noise-vs-real-bug triage, remote media, webview C++ features, PulseAudio, and the content-import framework. Read before touching viewer scheduling, messaging, streaming, upload/backup/import, or webview D-Bus code.
